title: Chapter 245 - 245 Saved; Mission Completed!
content:
Chapter 245 - 245 Saved; Mission Completed!

Chapter 245 - 245 Saved; Mission Completed!

245 Saved; Mission Completed!

The buzz-cut man’s appearance was already a little fierce. Under the dim light, he looked even more ferocious.

He held the knife in one hand and rummaged through the car with the other.

However, there was not even a piece of paper in the car, let alone money.

Could it be… Was he going to get nothing today?

Actually, this was normal.

After all, Lin Fan’s Santana was a gift from Volkswagen Group.

Lin Fan did not store any money in it.

Then, the buzz-cut man’s gaze fell on the car keys. His eyes moved slightly, and he raised the knife as he shouted, “Get out of the car!”

How could Lin Fan not see through his plans?

Lin Fan had been driving for quite some time and was feeling a little bored. As he wished, he opened the car door and got out.

When the man with the buzz cut walked out with the knife…

“Tsk!”

At this moment, a Volkswagen sped over from afar. The dazzling headlights made the buzz-cut man unable to open his eyes.

With lightning speed, a beautiful figure quickly ran out of the Volkswagen and grabbed the buzz-cut man, pressing him to the ground.

Then, the beautiful figure skillfully took out the handcuffs on her waist and cuffed the buzz-cut man’s hands.

Her movements were like flowing water, smooth and agile.

This scene…

Lin Fan saw everything.

The woman was tall, plump, and strong. Her facial features were exquisite and delicate. Her long black hair was tied up high and fluttered in the wind.

She was not as gentle as an ordinary woman. On the contrary, she had a heroic sense of beauty.

The high beam lights beside her were all focused on her… It caused her entire body to faintly emit a dazzling light.

At this moment…

Lin Fan had a strange feeling in his heart. It was as if… she was not a mortal woman but a female war god who descended from the sky!

Lin Fan could not help but use his Eyes of Truth to observe this beautiful woman.

[Appearance: 96]

[Favorability: 35]

At this moment, the beauty turned her body slowly and looked at Lin Fan with a scrutinizing gaze. She asked, “I’m from Jiangbei City. Who are you? Why did you come here with him? And why would he point a knife at you?”

“I received an order through DiDi to send him here,” Lin Fan said honestly. “Then, I was robbed by him.”

The beautiful office nodded noncommittally and said, “I understand. But now, I’ll have to trouble you to come with me to the investigation team to give a statement. Please cooperate.”

Obviously, she had made this arrangement for safety reasons.

The police would never believe a one-sided story. They had to go through a strict review to determine the truth.

Lin Fan understood their process and nodded. “Alright.”

After a while, a police vehicle drove over from afar, and the man with a buzz cut was brought inside.

Lin Fan got into the beautiful officer’s car while his Santana was driven away by another man.

After all, Lin Fan was a victim, and it was not suitable to treat him like a criminal.

If Lin Fan was a bad person, the beautiful officer believed that she could subdue him.

Of course, this was just the confidence of the beautiful officer.

Lin Fan sat in her car and looked around.

The interior of the car was spotless, very clean and tidy.

This… She was indeed a beautiful woman with a serious personality.

When Lin Fan’s gaze landed on the car’s armrest, he could not help but praise internally, ‘She’s indeed a beautiful woman with a score of 96. Her ID photo is so beautiful. Wang Ru? Her name is not bad either.’

At this time, Wang Ru said, “You didn’t seem scared at all?”

Lin Fan said, “After all, he’s just a robber with a knife.”

Wang Ru looked at Lin Fan and did not say anything.

With the sound of brakes, Lin Fan, Wang Ru, the buzz-cut man, and the others walked toward the investigation team.

The buzz-cut man was panicking while Lin Fan was very relaxed.

At this moment, the burly captain of the investigation team, Deng Jihu, happened to walk out with his head held high.

Wang Ru and the other detectives became serious and shouted, “Greetings, Captain!”

Deng Jihu nodded and prepared to continue walking forward.

In the next moment…

His body suddenly froze, and his pupils constricted.

That was because he saw Lin Fan.

“Mr. Lin!” Deng Jihu said excitedly.

“Leader Deng,” Lin Fan said.

“This… What happened?” Deng Jihu asked.

“It’s nothing serious. I was bored and went out to play on DiDi. Then, I was robbed by this guy with a buzz cut…” Lin Fan replied.

His tone was very calm as if he was talking about a trivial matter.

However, in Deng Jihu’s ears, it sounded like thunder.

Who was Lin Fan?

Old Master Qin Weiming was very fond of him!

Even the leaders of Jiang Province and Jiangbei City did not dare to show him any disrespect!

He was actually robbed with a knife?

How vile was this?

“Mr. Lin, are you hurt?” Deng Jihu asked in fear.

Lin Fan shook his head and said, “No. Wang Ru happened to pass by. She subdued the buzz-cut man.”

When Deng Jihu heard this, he heaved a sigh of relief and said, “It’s good that you’re fine. It’s good that you’re fine.”

Then, he said to Wang Ru, “Good job!”

In the end, he stared at the buzz-cut man and shouted, “Bring him in and interrogate him strictly. I want him to confess all the bad things he has done in his life!”

“Yes, Sir!” The few officers standing at the side became solemn and shouted in unison.

The buzz-cut man trembled in fear and almost fell to the ground.

Lin Fan asked, “Do I still have to go in and cooperate with the investigation?”

“There’s no need, there’s no need… It’s already so late. Mr. Lin, just go home and have a good rest,” Deng Jihu hurriedly said.

Lin Fan nodded his head and did not reject. He went back.

When he arrived at the Santana, a crisp notification sounded in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed the mission: Complete five special orders. You’ll receive five golden packets. Progress 5/5.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his eyes lit up immediately. He could not help but smile.

The mission was finally completed!

Five golden packets… What would he get?

Lin Fan’s heart was filled with a rare sense of excitement.

Therefore, he did not stop at the entrance of the police station. He stepped on the accelerator and sped forward.

Deng Jihu only retracted his gaze after Lin Fan’s Santana had completely disappeared from sight.

He did not go home. With a cold expression, he strode into the station.

Today, he had to teach the person who robbed Lin Fan a lesson!
